init.title: Configure parental control

data.actionable: Confirm button in the phone notification

data_description.media_players: When one of these TVs is switched on it must be confirmed, otherwise it is switched off again.
data_description.notify_services: Services like mobile_app_patrick. Includes a confirm button when enabled.
data_description.notify_entities: Entities for notify.send_message, e.g. a speech output in the living room.
data_description.announce_lock: Send a message to all targets when locked. If a TV is switched on meanwhile, notify entities (e.g. speech output) announce the lock time, at most once per minute.
data_description.presence_entities: If none of these persons is at home, any TV that is turned on is turned off right away. "Allow today" overrides this. Unknown or unavailable counts as home.

data.at_window_start: When a TV is running as the rules begin
data.pause_entities: Suspend time windows while on (e.g. holidays)

data_description.time_start: Outside the time window nothing is asked. Equal start and end means all day.
data_description.weekdays: Past midnight (e.g. 21:00 to 07:30) the morning belongs to the evening before.
data_description.at_window_start: Applies at "Active from" and when an exception or pause ends. Turning a TV on again requires confirmation.
data_description.warn_minutes: This many minutes before the time window starts and before the daily limit ends, a message is sent if a TV is on.
data_description.weekdays_2: Optional, e.g. other times on weekends. Without weekdays the second window is off.
data_description.pause_entities: While one of these entities is on (calendar with a holiday event, input_boolean, binary_sensor), the time windows do not apply. Daily limit and lock stay.
data_description.school_nights_only: The first window applies only on the evening before a school day (starting at noon or later) or on school days (starting in the morning). The weekdays above are ignored. School day: workday according to the sensor (Monday to Friday without one) and not during holidays.
data_description.workday_entity: Sensor of the Workday integration. Each day is checked individually, so public holidays count correctly.
data_description.holiday_calendars: Every event in these calendars counts as holidays: no school day and the holiday daily limit.

data_description.blocked_apps: Part of the app name or app ID, e.g. youtube. The app is closed immediately (home key via the remote entity, otherwise TV off), even after a normal confirmation.
data_description.app_block_always: On: the apps are closed at any time. Off: only in the time window. Release them with the code in the 'Enter code' field or with 'App freigeben' in the phone notification.
data_description.app_release_minutes: Blocked apps stay allowed this long after a release.
data_description.allowed_apps: Apps matching these entries are never closed, e.g. tvkids for YouTube Kids while youtube is blocked.

data_description.daily_limit_minutes: Every minute a TV is on counts. Once the limit is reached, TVs are turned off and every power-on needs confirmation until midnight.
data_description.daily_limit_weekend: Empty = same as other days, 0 = no limit.
data_description.daily_limit_holiday: Applies on holidays (holiday calendar or pause entity on). Empty = as usual, 0 = no limit.
data_description.bonus_minutes: The "Bonus time" button extends the daily limit and allows this many minutes without confirmation during the blocked period.

data.confirm_valid_minutes: Confirmation lasts (0 = until the TV is off)

data_description.confirm_code: 4 to 12 digits. When a code is set, only the 'Enter code' field or the confirm button on the phone confirms. The switch and additional confirmation switches no longer count. A wrong code counts as a failed attempt.
data_description.attempt_reset_minutes: If the last failed attempt is older than this, counting starts over.
data_description.confirm_entities: Optional: existing input_boolean or switch entities that can also confirm.
data_description.penalty_hours: The 'Penalty' button locks all TVs of this entry completely for this long. Only 'Unlock' ends it earlier.
data_description.confirm_valid_minutes: Afterwards a new confirmation is requested (with the warning). Without it the TV is turned off.
